releases.notes:
# VulkanBoost 0.6 for Minecraft 1.21.11

VulkanBoost 0.6 expands the single-JAR optimization bundle from 19 to 25 pinned top-level mod/library components. It adds Structure Layout Optimizer and Cull Leaves, plus their required libraries and the libraries needed for an optional Fast Item Frames companion.

## Changes

- Adds Structure Layout Optimizer 1.1.4 for Jigsaw structure and NBT-piece generation.
- Adds Cull Leaves 4.1.1.1 for leaf-face culling.
- Adds Resourceful Config 3.11.3 and MidnightLib 1.9.2 for the new optimizers.
- Adds Puzzles Lib 21.11.11 and Forge Config API Port 21.11.0 to support the optional Fast Item Frames add-on.
- Keeps all embedded components pinned to reproducible Modrinth Maven artifacts.
- CI checks nested-JAR integrity, component IDs and pinned versions, required root dependencies, and checker unit tests.

## Fast Item Frames licensing note

Fast Item Frames 21.11.1 for Minecraft 1.21.11 is not bundled. Its upstream repository has a separate LICENSE-ASSETS.md stating that its resource assets are All Rights Reserved. The complete JAR must not be redistributed as part of VulkanBoost without the author's permission. Download it from the official [Modrinth version page](https://modrinth.com/mod/fast-item-frames/version/4QQcgJi6) and install it separately. In multiplayer it is required on both client and server; follow its official dependency instructions for the dedicated server.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
- Java 21
- Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or compatible release meeting the declared minimum
- VulkanMod 0.6.8+1.21.11 and a GPU/driver supporting Vulkan 1.2+

## Installation

1. Download the VulkanBoost-0.6-for-1.21.11.jar file.
2. Place it in the Minecraft profile's mods folder.
3. Remove separate copies of any components already bundled inside VulkanBoost to avoid duplicate mod IDs.
4. Use a test profile and back up worlds before testing. Structure-generation mixins can conflict with other mods that alter the same generation path.

Fabric Loader and Java are installed separately. This release still does not implement a custom upscaler, FXAA/SMAA, DLSS/DLAA, or temporal AA. A successful build is not a substitute for in-game compatibility testing.

# VulkanBoost 0.5 for Minecraft 1.21.11

This refreshed package preserves VulkanBoost's single-JAR optimization bundle and removes the experimental custom rendering integration that caused visual artifacts. The package does not include a custom upscaling or temporal anti-aliasing implementation.

## Changes

- Retains the pinned set of 19 bundled mod and library components.
- Removes custom rendering hooks and the prior resolution-scaling integration.
- Keeps the development focus on a stable baseline before adding any new image-quality pipeline.
- Validates nested-JAR integrity, component IDs and versions, and the expected project-owned runtime structure.

## Compatibility

- Minecraft Java Edition 1.21.11
- Java 21
- Fabric Loader 0.20.1 or compatible release meeting the declared minimum
- VulkanMod 0.6.8+1.21.11 and a GPU/driver supporting Vulkan 1.2+

## Installation

1. Download `VulkanBoost-0.5-for-1.21.11.jar`.
2. Place it in the Minecraft profile's `mods` folder.
3. Remove separate copies of any components already bundled inside VulkanBoost to avoid duplicate mod IDs.
4. Use a test profile and back up worlds before testing.

Fabric Loader and Java are installed separately. The bundle remains experimental; a successful build is not a substitute for in-game compatibility testing. Native-resolution anti-aliasing and temporal reconstruction are not implemented in this package.

# VulkanBoost 0.4.11 for Minecraft 1.21.11

This release removes VulkanBoost's custom damage-camera integration and leaves the official BetterHurtCam component as an unmodified nested dependency.

## Changes

- Removes all custom Java code used for damage-camera settings, the first-server setup prompt, and the custom settings key.
- Removes the config bridge and one-time migration from previous VulkanBoost settings. BetterHurtCam now owns its normal configuration directly.
- Removes all VulkanBoost translation files and the custom Russian resource overlay for BetterHurtCam.
- Removes the root client entrypoint. VulkanBoost adds no runtime classes, mixins, screens, keybindings, configuration wrappers, or resource patches for BetterHurtCam.
- Keeps the pinned upstream BetterHurtCam 1.12.0+mc1.21.11 Modrinth Maven artifact and Ukulib 1.10.2+1.21.11 unchanged inside the single JAR.
- Leaves the remaining optimization bundle unchanged.

## Verification

- CI builds the Java 21 remapped JAR and checks all 19 nested components, including the exact BetterHurtCam and Ukulib mod versions.
- CI also rejects root runtime classes, entrypoints, mixins, or asset overlays, so the bundle cannot silently reintroduce a custom layer around BetterHurtCam.
- A successful build validates compilation and packaging, not gameplay; the full bundle still needs real Minecraft 1.21.11 runtime testing.
- If you upgraded from an earlier version, an obsolete settings-state file may remain in your config folder. Version 0.4.11 no longer reads it; it can be deleted.

## Installation

Download `VulkanBoost-0.4.11-for-1.21.11.jar` and place it in `mods`. Remove separate copies of mods already bundled in VulkanBoost to avoid duplicate mod IDs.

releases.notes:
# VulkanBoost 0.4.10 for Minecraft 1.21.11

Clarity update for the built-in BetterHurtCam slider. Its percentage now describes the BetterHurtCam camera effect directly instead of saying only “reduce hurt-camera tilt.”

## Slider meaning

- **0% — no visible BetterHurtCam camera effect:** camera tilt behaves like vanilla Minecraft.
- **50% — partial effect:** about half of the hurt-camera tilt is removed.
- **100% — full effect:** hurt-camera tilt is fully removed.
- The slider is labeled **“BetterHurtCam effect: X%”** in English and **“Эффект BetterHurtCam: X%”** in Russian.
- The setup wizard uses the same explanation, and CI checks that the English and Russian labels and help text match the intended meaning.
- This is a UI/wording update: the underlying mapping remains the same (BetterHurtCam multiplier 1.0 at 0%, 0.5 at 50%, and 0.0 at 100%).

## Included since 0.4.9

- Bundles the unmodified upstream BetterHurtCam 1.12.0+mc1.21.11 JAR and required Ukulib 1.10.2+1.21.11 JAR in the single VulkanBoost artifact.
- The VulkanBoost setup wizard and settings screen continue to read and write BetterHurtCam's real configuration.
- Russian translations for BetterHurtCam's UI and hotkeys remain included.
- The non-blurred screen backgrounds from 0.4.9 remain in place to avoid the previously reported `Can only blur once per frame` crash.

## Verification

- CI builds the Java 21 remapped JAR and checks all 19 nested components, including BetterHurtCam and Ukulib, unique mod IDs, the absence of the old competing mixin, the config bridge, matching locale keys, and the slider's 0%/50%/100% semantics.
- A successful build verifies compilation and packaging, not gameplay. The new wording and the 0.4.9 crash fix still need confirmation in a real Minecraft 1.21.11 client.
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Java 21 and a Vulkan 1.2+ compatible GPU/driver are required. Fabric Loader itself is not bundled.

## Installation

Download `VulkanBoost-0.4.10-for-1.21.11.jar` and place it in `mods`. Remove separate copies of mods already bundled in VulkanBoost to avoid duplicate mod IDs.

# VulkanBoost 0.4.9 for Minecraft 1.21.11

Integration and crash-fix update: use official BetterHurtCam and prevent the first-server setup screen from crashing while drawing its background.

## Changes

- Bundles the unmodified upstream BetterHurtCam 1.12.0+mc1.21.11 JAR and required Ukulib 1.10.2+1.21.11 JAR in the single VulkanBoost artifact.
- Removes the custom VulkanBoost hurt-camera mixin and its mixin registration so two competing implementations cannot target GameRenderer.
- Keeps the VulkanBoost first-multiplayer-join setup prompt and settings UI; they now read and write BetterHurtCam's actual config through its public manager.
- Migrates previous VulkanBoost reduction/enabled values into BetterHurtCam once. After migration, BetterHurtCam's `config/betterhurtcam.toml` is the single source of truth; setup-complete state remains in the legacy properties file.
- The reduction slider maps to BetterHurtCam's multiplier: 0% reduction = 1.0 (vanilla tilt), 50% = 0.5, 100% = 0.0 (tilt removed).
- Removes the duplicate VulkanBoost toggle binding. BetterHurtCam's real Toggle, Increase Strength and Decrease Strength actions appear in the standard Controls menu; VulkanBoost keeps its separate settings-opening key.
- Adds Russian translations for BetterHurtCam's UI and hotkeys.
- Fixes the 0.4.8 crash `IllegalStateException: Can only blur once per frame`. Both VulkanBoost screens now draw a normal dark background instead of invoking the blurred background path twice.
- Preserves all existing optimization mods and includes both upstream license notices.

## Upstream sources and licenses

- [BetterHurtCam 1.12.0+mc1.21.11](https://github.com/uku3lig/betterhurtcam/tree/1.21.11) — MIT
- [Ukulib 1.10.2+1.21.11](https://github.com/uku3lig/ukulib/releases/tag/1.10.2+1.21.11) — MPL-2.0

## Verification

- CI builds the Java 21 remapped JAR and checks all 19 nested components, including BetterHurtCam and Ukulib, the absence of the old competing mixin, the config migration bridge, Russian translations, and non-blurred rendering on both VulkanBoost screens.
- A successful build verifies compilation and packaging, not gameplay. BetterHurtCam's effect and the fix still need confirmation in a real Minecraft 1.21.11 client.
- Fabric Loader 0.19.3+, Java 21 and a Vulkan 1.2+ compatible GPU/driver are required. Fabric Loader itself is not bundled.

## Bundled components

- Fabric API 0.140.2+1.21.11
- VulkanMod 0.6.8+1.21.11

- FerriteCore 8.2.0-fabric

Download `VulkanBoost-0.4.9-for-1.21.11.jar` and place it in `mods`. Remove separate copies of mods already bundled in VulkanBoost to avoid duplicate mod IDs.
